features.title: Healings
features.body: Lama Fera, Shalvik Mantra Rahasya, Saropa, Reiki, or Hunkara with Haleemi. Priya picks the method after she hears what you are carrying — not from a fixed list.

features.title: Ritual Castings
features.body: A candle named to the matter — healing, a relation, protection, a clearing, love, or a blessing. She will say what she needs from you first, then how the candle is held.

features.title: Akashic Records
features.body: A guided hour in the records. Used when you need to see the thread of a life, and what is asking to be understood now. Not a performance.

features.title: PLR (Past Life Regression) Therapy
features.body: When a present matter feels older than this life. She holds the hour quietly, so what is pressing can be seen without force.

features.title: Hoodoo
features.body: Work with Saints and spirits, named to the situation you bring. Not a generic ritual off a list. Priya will say what she needs first.
features.imageAlt: A candle and figure prepared for spirit work

features.title: Divinations
features.body: Tarot, dowsing, smoke, or runes. The method follows the question, not a habit. You leave knowing what is going on, and what to do next.
features.imageAlt: Cards laid out for a reading

features.title: Meditations
features.body: Sound, breath, bowl, water, chanting, or a fully guided hour. Meant to settle you, then send you back to the week with something you can keep.

faq.title: About the sittings
faq.intro: The questions people ask before they book one.

items.a: If you already know, book that one. If you do not, write Priya what is going on. She will say whether it is a healing, a ritual, a reading, or something else.

items.q: Can these be done if I am not in Dehradun?
items.a: Most of them, yes. Say you need the work at a distance when you write. She will tell you if that sitting can be held that way.

items.q: What is the difference between a healing and a reading?
items.a: A healing is work done on what you are carrying. A reading (tarot, dowsing, smoke, or runes) is to see what is present and what to do next. Some people need both. She will say if that is you.

items.q: Do I need to prepare anything?
items.a: For most sittings, a clear note of the matter is enough. For a candle ritual she may ask for names or a detail first. She will tell you before the hour.
